It’s virtually impossible, in my opinion, to explain why men’s and women’s college basketball is at all time highs and the NBA is at all time lows without pointing to the NBA’s woke politics as the most likely culprit. But I’m curious to see above results.

NBA ratings are at multi-decade lows for the NBA Finals. The NBA’s all time most watched game was in 1998. This year the NCAA tourney is setting all time record viewership. The Super Bowl all time high was two years ago. Why has NBA tanked while other leagues soared? Vote below.

Are there multiple factors that have led to the NBA setting multi decade low ratings? Sure. Load management, tanking, arrogant players & coaches that seem to hate the fans, all of these impact things negatively too. But going woke alienated more people than anything in my always humble opinion. It’s definitely not basketball. The NCAA Tourney ratings prove how much people still love basketball. Austin, you are really, really dumb. The NBA’s signature event is the NBA Finals. It’s at multi-decade viewership lows. Below is the chart. The NCAA Tourney opening weekend just posted its highest ratings EVER. The NBA’s highest ratings ever were in 1998, nearly 30 years ago.
